The journalist must be to the right of the adventure‑watcher, so with only two positions the adventure‑watcher is at position 1 and the journalist at position 2.  
Since each job appears once, the police‑officer is at position 1 (the adventure‑watcher) and the journalist is at position 2.  
The police‑officer cannot share the filmmaking hobby, so the person at position 1 (police‑officer) has the collecting hobby, leaving the journalist at position 2 with the filmmaking hobby.  
The adventure‑watcher (position 1) watches adventure, so the remaining person (position 2) watches thriller and holds the journalist job.

Thus:
- Adventure‑watcher’s position: 1  
- Journalist’s hobby: filmmaking  
- Adventure‑watcher’s job: police‑officer  
- Thriller‑watcher’s job: journalist  

<solution>1, filmmaking, police-officer, journalist</solution>
Final answer: 1, filmmaking, police-officer, journalist
